svg.title: Proactive functions mapped onto the original architecture
svg.desc: Left: the unchanged original layout with numbered component highlights. Right: functions to configure or implement in each numbered component. Select a component or function to expand the implementation details.

svg.title: Phase 0.5 — digital colleague reference architecture (one colleague)
svg.desc: A layered reference architecture for one digital colleague. A person reaches it through one interaction surface. OpenClaw-style workspace files define identity, persona, operating rules, user context, skills, and memory. The Runtime Controller invokes a dedicated Request Triage and Priority component to apply authored policy before Codex app-server work proceeds. Each external-service integration adds an inbound trigger through a webhook or bounded polling, plus outbound capabilities through an MCP tool server and the vendor API. Access, permission, and audit are cross-cutting concerns beneath all layers.
svg.text: Layered components. Orange = we author. Blue = human surface & the security boundary. Grey = off-the-shelf runtime, engine, and services.
web / desktop / embodied UI · the only human-facing channel (ADR-019)
DIGITAL COLLEAGUE · AUTHORED WORKSPACE + TRIAGE POLICY; OFF-THE-SHELF RUNTIME & ENGINE
sessions · approvals · workspace loading · dispatch · app-server client
apply AGENTS.md + skills/ policy · classify · urgency · impact · approval need · route / order
agent loop · thread/turn lifecycle · MCP client · approvals · streamed events
SERVICE INTEGRATION · EACH SERVICE ADDS TWO BINDINGS: INBOUND TRIGGER + OUTBOUND TOOL
renew push TTL · else events stop
INBOUND B · bounded polling when no push
EXTERNAL SERVICES · EXPAND BY INTEGRATING, WITHOUT CHANGING THE COLLEAGUE RUNTIME
ACCESS · PERMISSIONS · AUDIT · cross-cutting — bounds every layer above
